name: swagga-hq
description: SwaGGa HQ — Personal command center for trading, learning, and daily habit tracking.

scripts.copy: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; New-Item dist -ItemType Directory | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html dist/; Copy-Item manifest.json dist/; Copy-Item sw.js dist/; Copy-Item -Recurse js dist/js; Copy-Item -Recurse css dist/css; Copy-Item -Recurse img dist/img"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:run: npm run copy && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:build: npm run copy && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
